About the Ranch Camp Ladies Rides group ride

Free women's mountain bike rides led by Ranch Camp ambassadors, with LGBTQ+ riders explicitly welcome. Trailheads rotate around Stowe and occasionally Woodstock. Some rides are catered; order food by the Friday before. Sign up on Eventbrite.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
